title: Account signal translation to implementation pathway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Sales/CS teams surface high-touch enterprise asks that are fragmented across deals and channels. We need a lightweight, repeatable pathway that translates account signals into an implementation-ready scoped proposal (1-pager + effort band + blockers) within a 5-10 business day SLA for prioritized asks. Goal: reduce turnaround time, improve engineering predictability, and provide Sales with an immediately actionable deliverable for contract conversations.
background: Current intake suffers from inconsistent signal capture (missing acceptance criteria, customer environment details, security constraints) and ad-hoc prioritization. Existing playbooks focus on aggregation and triage but stop short of a prescriptive handoff that engineering can estimate reliably. This ticket defines the 'translation pathway' and associated artifacts, scoring tweaks, and a pilot roll for high-value accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Define a 5-step pathway from Sales signal -> PM synth -> Technical feasibility check -> Scoped proposal -> Sales handoff
Publish a one-page scoped-proposal template that includes acceptance criteria, BAA/P0 compliance flags, estimated effort band, and rollout constraints
Implement a scoring heuristic (Signal Score) that combines customer tier, incremental ARR estimate, technical risk, and required infra changes
Run pilot on 6 active enterprise asks from Sales/CS and collect time-to-delivery and stakeholder satisfaction metrics
Document the handoff checklist and update the enterprise intake Confluence page
notes: This pathway intentionally biases toward faster time-to-proposal for accounts above a tier-2 threshold. For lower-tier asks we keep the aggregated queue + quarterly batching approach. We will create a small 'scoping SWAT' group from Solutions Eng + Runtime to speed feasibility checks during pilot.

risks_and_tradeoffs: Speed vs fidelity: fast scoping may miss subtle infra constraints leading to rework
Resource contention: SWAT team draws on Solutions Eng and Runtime during pilot, reducing availability for planned sprints
Sales overrides risk: allowing VP overrides reduces consistency in prioritization; will require audit and review cadence
Security gating may push some asks into longer timelines and require parallel workstreams
implementation_notes: Use the existing enterprise intake form but add three mandatory fields: acceptance_criteria, customer-environment, and required-compliance. Build a small GSheet-based Signal Score tool for the pilot to avoid engineering cycles; migrate to a simple internal microservice if pilot proves successful.
next_steps: Publish template and Confluence page by 2026-03-14
Kick off pilot scoping sprint on 2026-03-15
Collect metrics: time-to-proposal, pilot conversion to contract, engineering rework hours
Run retrospective and decide on automation (GSheet -> internal tool) by 2026-03-29
qa_notes: Pilot will include validation of acceptance criteria clarity with Solutions Eng and a sample run where an engineer performs a blind feasibility estimate using only the scoped-proposal 1-pager. Pass condition: estimates within one effort band (S/M/L) of final engineering estimate in 4/6 pilot cases.
